name: boardId
label: Board

nested.name: phaseId
nested.label: Phase
nested.help: Only cards currently in this phase.

help: The board to search in. Perpetuus searches cards one board at a time.

name: query
label: Title contains
help: Text contained in the card title, case-insensitive. Leave empty to list every card.

name: contactId
label: Contact
help: Only cards linked to this contact. To find the cards of an email, use Search contacts first and map the contact ID here.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: Maximum number of cards to return. Perpetuus is read in pages of 100, and further pages are requested until this number is reached. Leave it empty to return up to 100.
